compos.summarization: This smartphone UI screen is part of an application related to the "Mayan chart." The main content displayed is a date selection dialog for setting "Mother's Birthday." The user can scroll through a list of years (in this case, 1926, 1927, and 1928 are visible) and select a specific year. The selected date is shown at the top of the dialog (Tue, May 10, 1927). There are two action buttons at the bottom of the dialog: "CANCEL" to dismiss the dialog without making a selection, and "OK" to confirm the selected date. The background of the screen shows a partially visible advertisement for an app called "Mirror no ads."
